description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS file, and the main App component. It initializes the React rendering process by creating a root element and rendering the App component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components, taking a DOM element as an argument.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
